hook.say: True or false? Five island facts, three seconds each. The last one sounds impossible!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Madagascar is the world's largest island.
questions.fact: Greenland is the largest. Madagascar is only fourth.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Greenland is the largest. Madagascar ranks only fourth.

questions.q: The island of Borneo is shared by three countries.
questions.fact: Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei all have territory on Borneo.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei all have territory on Borneo.

questions.q: Sicily is the largest island in the Mediterranean.
questions.fact: Sicily is about 25,500 km², just ahead of Sardinia.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Sicily is the largest, just ahead of Sardinia.

questions.q: Japan is made up of just four islands.
questions.sayAnswer: False! A 2023 government count found 14125 islands.

questions.q: More people live on the island of Java than in all of Russia.
questions.fact: Java: about 158 million people. Russia: about 146 million.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Java has about 158 million people. Russia has about 146 million.
